g.text: would u believe I just listened to an album that dropped the line "chicks actin dumb" in four different songs?
straight to the trash it goooes!
Besides those lyrics, was the rest of the album okay?
Yeesh. Say what you will about the Orokin, but you can't deny they wrote more eloquent lyrics than that.
meaning aside, using the same line that many times is TOTALLY unoriginal
... but I admit my personal experience might be clouding my judgement. other parts of the album were fine.
should I fish it out of the trash for u so u can give it an unbiased listen? ^_^
I'll pass, but I'd love to hear what personal experience you're referring to.
Back up. Personal experience? Who's ever called you a "chick acting dumb?"
Hah. No thanks. I hope the next album you listen to is more enjoyable. [End.]
even u've called called me "dumb" before
even when I served with distinction in the ICR. Officer Barnier saw me bopping to a song in my head one time and said, "We need to do something about that one. She's ditzy."
He was just jealous that you knew how to have fun.
Would it have killed him to mind his own business?
me: "swear on something important to u"
well, it said more about him than me. he showed me nice and early that he wasn't worth my time
It's coming back to me now. In my defense, I meant the pinky swear stuff, not you.
Oh. Right. I think I remember that. Sorry, that was rude.
Ah I remember now. Well, it was dumb, but it was also cute. Sorry I upset you.
I pinky swear to swear on stuff that's important to me in the future. Lol.
Yeah, a guy like that isn't worth anybody's time.
No, it is. I shouldn't have said that.
it didn't wound me too badly anyway
enh I wish him well but u've gotta pick ur battles
I'll hold u to that! but don't sweat it lol
I came to the conclusion a long time ago that it's an advantage to be seen as ditzy
it means I'm being underestimated. I can do anything and nobody will even think to stand in my way
You're really something else, Aoi. I mean that in the best way.
To each their own, I guess.
oh I just luv our talks
we all have our own ways of getting by
so do u want me to fish that album out of the trash for u? lol
Nah, you're way too cute for... trash fishing.
Keep it in the trash where it belongs.
Thanks, but I'll stick to shawzin music.
very well! I'm off to clean my brain with Party of Ur Lifetime ^_^
